title: 2004 AMC 12A Problem 16
statement: The set of all real numbers \(x\) for which \[\small \log_{2004}(\log_{2003}(\log_{2002}(\log_{2001} x)))\] is defined is \(\{x \mid x \gt c\}.\) What is the value of \(c?\)

solutions.text:
The expression is defined if and only if \(\log_{2003}(\log_{2002}(\log_{2001} x)) \gt 0,\) that is, \(\log_{2002}(\log_{2001} x) \gt 1.\)

This holds if and only if \(\log_{2001} x \gt 2002,\) which is equivalent to \(x \gt 2001^{2002}.\)

Therefore \(c = 2001^{2002}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Work from the outside in: each logarithm requires its argument to be positive
\(\log_{2004}(\cdots)\) is defined only when \(\log_{2003}(\cdots) \gt 0,\) i.e. the next argument exceeds \(1\)
